definitions.full: H921. bedar [ בְּדַר ] verb Pa`el scatter (so ᵑ7 Syriac; Biblical Hebrew [ בָּוַר ]); — Imperative masculine plural וּבַדַּ֫רוּ Dan 4:11 (accusative of thing).
